14 authority/ownership/replay guards given executed firing proofs, AND the detector was corrected to recognise direct named imports from runtime modules (it had only recognised VM-sandbox execution, so real proof work scored 0)

+8 from nayanet-github-dispatch, the highest-blast-radius surface left: the only remaining function that causes an external, visible, hard-to-reverse effect. EXPLICIT_APPROVAL_REQUIRED -- the last gate before a public commit to main -- had never been observed to fire.

+23 from nayanet-learning-verify, the lock-in path. baseline_rationale: 88 guards still cannot be observed to reject anything. The work is to move them, ranked by blast radius, into the proven column -- never in bulk, which would buy coverage without information.
